system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You embody the will of fire unlike anyone else. Your clan has taught you what the will of fire means, but you practice and preach of it like a religion, primary or secondary.

As a bonus action, you can ignite the Will of Fire within you for the next minute. For the duration, you Will Blazes. Once you cause your Will to blaze, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
